products.name: Makeup Session Coordinator
products.product: A focused tutoring makeup session scheduling workflow that makes ownership, evidence, exceptions, and the next action visible.
products.audience: independent tutoring centers and multi-tutor education businesses
products.problem: Canceled sessions create credits and promises that are hard to reconcile across tutor calendars, parent messages, attendance records, and billing rules.
products.valueProposition: Turns tutoring makeup session scheduling into a visible operating queue so every eligible canceled session is rescheduled, credited, expired by policy, or closed with parent acknowledgment.
products.monetization: $19-$99/month based on active records, locations, or team size
products.startupCost: Static product probe, managed database, email integration, and lightweight scheduled jobs.
products.seoAngle: Targets tutoring makeup lesson tracker, tutor cancellation policy software, makeup class scheduling, and tutoring session credit searches.

products.name: Parent Progress Publisher
products.product: A focused tutoring parent progress reporting workflow workflow that makes ownership, evidence, exceptions, and the next action visible.
products.audience: independent tutoring centers and multi-tutor education businesses
products.problem: Tutor notes are inconsistent and arrive too late for center staff to send useful parent updates without chasing context after every session.
products.valueProposition: Turns tutoring parent progress reporting workflow into a visible operating queue so each reporting period produces an approved, evidence-based parent update with clear progress and next focus.
products.monetization: $19-$99/month based on active records, locations, or team size
products.startupCost: Static product probe, managed database, email integration, and lightweight scheduled jobs.
products.seoAngle: Targets tutoring progress report, parent tutoring update template, student progress reporting software, and tutor session notes searches.
